title: Concept: Framework version disclosed (X-AspNetMvc-Version header)
description: The X-AspNetMvc-Version response header advertises the framework version that rendered the page. Attackers use the version to choose which public issues to try against the deployment, so the header removes a step from reconnaissance even when nothing is exploitable.
risk: Framework version is disclosed on every response; LOW severity because it is reconnaissance aid rather than an access path.
